title: Lambda Expressions in Java
contentMd:
A lambda expression is a concise way to represent an anonymous function, a block of code that can be passed around like data. Before Java 8, expressing behavior as a parameter meant writing a verbose anonymous inner class. With lambdas and the arrow syntax, (a, b) -> a + b reads exactly as "given a and b, return their sum" without ceremony.

Under the hood a lambda is not an anonymous class. The compiler translates it into an invokedynamic call that, on first use, creates a function object bound to a functional interface. This makes lambdas cheaper than inner classes and lets the JVM optimize them over time. The lambda can only use variables from the enclosing scope if they are effectively final, meaning they are assigned once and never changed.

In a backend interview, lambdas matter because they are the foundation of the Stream API and modern callback style. A common trap is capturing a mutable local variable or doing heavy work inside a lambda used in a parallel stream, which can serialize execution or cause data races. Used well, lambdas make code shorter and intent clearer; used carelessly, they hide side effects that are hard to debug.
contentCn:
Lambda 表达式是一种简洁地表示匿名函数的方式——也就是一段可以像数据一样被传递的代码块。在 Java 8 之前，要把行为作为参数传递，只能写一个冗长的匿名内部类。而通过使用箭头语法，lambda 让 (a, b) -> a + b 直白地表达“给定 a 和 b，返回它们的和”，没有任何多余仪式。

在底层，lambda 并不是匿名内部类。编译器会把它翻译成一次 invokedynamic 调用，在首次使用时创建一个绑定到某个函数式接口（functional interface）的函数对象。这让 lambda 比内部类更轻量，也让 JVM 能够随着时间推移对其进行优化。lambda 只能使用来自外围作用域、且“事实上不可变（effectively final）”的变量——也就是只赋值一次、此后不再修改的变量。

在后端面试中，lambda 之所以重要，是因为它是 Stream API 和现代回调风格的基石。一个常见陷阱是捕获可变局部变量，或在一个用于并行流的 lambda 中做繁重工作，这会让执行被串行化，甚至引发数据竞争。用得好，lambda 让代码更短、意图更清晰；用得随意，则会埋下难以排查的副作用。
titleCn: Java 中的 Lambda 表达式

title: The Stream API Pipeline
contentMd:
The Stream API, introduced in Java 8, lets you describe collection processing as a chain of operations rather than hand-written loops. You obtain a stream from a source, apply intermediate steps such as filter and map, and close with a terminal operation like collect, count, or reduce that actually triggers the work.

Intermediate operations are lazy: they build a description of the pipeline but do nothing until a terminal operation runs. This means an expensive map is evaluated only for elements that survive the filter, and techniques like limit or findFirst can stop processing early without touching the rest of the data.

The biggest mistake candidates make is reusing a stream, which is single-use and throws IllegalStateException on a second terminal call. Another is mutating the source collection while streaming. A well-formed pipeline keeps each step pure and stateless, which makes it both easier to test and safe to reason about whether it runs sequentially or in parallel.
contentCn:
Java 8 引入的 Stream API，让你用一连串操作来描述集合处理，而不必手写循环。你从一个数据源拿到流，施加 filter、map 这样的中间步骤，最后用 collect、count 或 reduce 这样的终端操作收尾，真正的工作就是由这个终端操作触发的。

中间操作是惰性的：它们只构建出流水线的“描述”，在终端操作运行之前什么都不做。这意味着昂贵的 map 只会对通过 filter 的元素求值，而 limit、findFirst 这类技巧还能提前结束，根本不去处理剩余数据。

面试者最常犯的错误是重复使用同一个流——流是一次性的，第二次调用终端操作会抛出 IllegalStateException。另一个错误是在流式处理过程中修改源集合。一条良好的流水线会让每一步都保持纯粹、无状态，这样无论顺序执行还是并行执行，它都既易于测试又便于推理。

title: Avoiding Null with Optional
contentMd:
Optional is a container object introduced in Java 8 to make the absence of a value explicit. Instead of returning null and hoping the caller remembers to check, a method can return Optional<User>, signaling that a result may be missing. This shifts a common runtime bug into a compile-time conversation.

The value of Optional is the fluent API it provides: orElse supplies a default, orElseGet computes one lazily, ifPresent runs code only when a value exists, and flatMap chains further optional-returning calls without nested null checks. Used in a return position, it documents intent and guides the caller toward safe handling.

The pitfall is treating Optional as a cure-all. It should not be used for fields, method parameters, or collection elements, where a normal null check or empty collection is clearer and cheaper. Calling get() without isPresent() defeats the purpose and can throw NoSuchElementException. Reach for Optional to represent an optional return value, not to wrap every nullable reference in your codebase.
contentCn:
Optional 是 Java 8 引入的容器对象，用来把“值缺失”这件事显式表达出来。比起返回 null 并指望调用方记得做判空，一个方法可以返回 Optional<User>，明确告诉调用方结果可能不存在。这把一个常见的运行时 bug 提前成了编译期就应当讨论的问题。

Optional 的价值在于它提供的流式 API：orElse 给出一个默认值，orElseGet 惰性计算一个默认值，ifPresent 只在值存在时才执行代码，而 flatMap 能链式串联更多返回 Optional 的调用，无需层层嵌套的判空。用在返回值位置上，它既记录了意图，也引导调用方安全地处理结果。

它的陷阱在于被当成万能药。Optional 不该用于字段、方法参数或集合元素——在这些地方，一次普通的判空或返回一个空集合反而更清晰、更廉价。在没有 isPresent() 的情况下调用 get()，会违背初衷并可能抛出 NoSuchElementException。请把 Optional 用来表示“可选的返回值”，而不是把它套进代码里每一个可空引用。
titleCn: 用 Optional 规避空指针

title: Default Methods in Interfaces
contentMd:
Java 8 allowed interfaces to carry default methods, declared with the default keyword and providing a concrete implementation. This was primarily a pragmatic move so that the Collection interface could gain stream() and forEach() without forcing every existing implementation to be rewritten.

Default methods enable a limited form of multiple inheritance of behavior. When a class implements two interfaces that both define the same default method, the compiler refuses to pick a winner and requires the class to override the method explicitly, often with InterfaceA.super.method() to choose one. This resolves ambiguity at the source rather than by hidden rules.

They are not a replacement for abstract classes, because an interface still cannot hold state and a default method can only call other interface methods. A sound use is providing stable convenience behavior on top of a few abstract methods, as List does with replaceAll. Overusing them to share logic tends to muddy the contract that an interface is supposed to represent.
contentCn:
Java 8 允许接口携带默认方法（default method），用 default 关键字声明并给出具体实现。这主要是一项务实之举：让 Collection 接口得以新增 stream() 和 forEach() 等方法，却不必强迫每一个既有的实现类都重写一遍。

默认方法带来了一种受限的“行为多重继承”。当一个类同时实现了两个接口，而这两个接口都定义了同一个默认方法时，编译器不会擅自替你做选择，而是要求该类显式重写该方法，通常借助 InterfaceA.super.method() 来明确选定其一。这样，歧义被消解在了源码层面，而不是靠隐晦的规则。

默认方法并不能取代抽象类，因为接口依然不能持有状态，默认方法也只能源调用接口上的其他方法。一个恰当用法是：在少数抽象方法之上提供稳定的便捷行为，正如 List 用 replaceAll 做的那样。若把它们过度用于共享逻辑，往往会模糊接口本该表达的契约。

title: The Modern Date and Time API
contentMd:
The java.time package, added in Java 8, replaced the error-prone java.util.Date and Calendar. The old classes were mutable, had a zero-based month, and stored years as offsets from 1900, all of which caused countless off-by-one bugs. The new API is built around immutable, clearly named classes such as LocalDate, LocalTime, LocalDateTime, and ZonedDateTime.

Each type models exactly what its name says. LocalDate holds a date with no time or zone, ideal for birthdays and deadlines. ZonedDateTime adds the zone rules needed for correct scheduling across regions. Because the objects are immutable, operations like plusDays return a new instance instead of changing the old one, which makes date math thread-safe by construction.

Time zones and daylight saving are where the old API failed most often. With java.time you separate the instant on the timeline, represented by Instant, from the human-facing local view, and conversion is explicit and checked. In an interview, being able to contrast the immutability and clarity of java.time with the mutable legacy classes shows you understand why the redesign was necessary.
contentCn:
Java 8 新增的 java.time 包，取代了问题多多的 java.util.Date 和 Calendar。旧类是可变的，月份从 0 开始计数，年份还要以 1900 为基准做偏移，这些都制造了数不清的“差一”类 bug。新 API 建立在一组不可变、命名清晰的类型之上，例如 LocalDate、LocalTime、LocalDateTime 与 ZonedDateTime。

每个类型都精确对应它的名字所表达的含义。LocalDate 只持有日期、不含时间与时区，非常适合生日和截止日期这类场景。ZonedDateTime 则附加了跨地区排程所需的时区规则。因为这些对象不可变，像 plusDays 这样的操作会返回一个新实例，而非修改旧对象，这使得日期运算天生就是线程安全的。

时区与夏令时正是旧 API 最常翻车的地方。在 java.time 中，你用 Instant 表示时间线上的那个“时刻”，用面向人的本地视图表示本地时间，二者分离，并且转换是显式且经过校验的。面试时，能拿 java.time 的不可变与清晰去对比可变的旧类，就说明你理解了这次重新设计的必要性。
titleEn: The Modern Date and Time API

title: Method References
contentMd:
A method reference is shorthand for a lambda that simply forwards its arguments to an existing method. Where you might write s -> System.out.println(s), the form System.out::println expresses the same behavior with less noise, and the compiler infers the parameter types for you.

There are four common shapes. A static reference like Integer::parseInt maps a class method to a function, an instance-on-receiver form like String::length calls a method on the argument, an instance-on-supplied-object form like obj::doWork binds to a specific instance, and a constructor reference like ArrayList::new acts as a factory.

Method references improve readability when the lambda body is a single delegated call, but they are not always clearer. If the logic involves more than passing arguments through, an explicit lambda keeps intent obvious. In interviews, candidates who reach for method references appropriately signal fluency with the functional style rather than merely knowing it exists.
contentCn:
方法引用（method reference）是 lambda 的一种简写：当 lambda 只是把自己的参数转交给某个既有方法时，就可以用它。你本来可以写作 s -> System.out.println(s)，而用 System.out::println 就能以更少的噪声表达相同行为，参数类型还由编译器替你推断。

它有四种常见形态。像 Integer::parseInt 这样的静态引用把类方法映射成函数；String::length 这种“接收者上调用”形式对参数调用其方法；obj::doWork 这种“绑定到特定实例”形式绑定到某个具体对象；而 ArrayList::new 这样的构造器引用则充当工厂。

当 lambda 主体只是一次单纯的委派调用时，方法引用能提升可读性，但它并不总是更清晰。如果逻辑不只是“透传参数”，那么显式写出 lambda 反而能让意图更明显。面试中，那些恰当地选用方法引用的人，传递出的是对函数式风格的熟练运用，而不只是“知道有这东西”。

title: Local Variable Type Inference with var
contentMd:
Java 10 introduced var, which lets the compiler infer the type of a local variable from its initializer. Writing var users = new ArrayList<User>() keeps the concrete type obvious from the right-hand side while sparing you from repeating a long generic signature.

It is important to understand what var is not. It is not a dynamic or weakly typed feature; the variable still has a precise static type checked at compile time, and the bytecode is identical to writing the type explicitly. var can only be used for locals with an initializer, not for fields, method parameters, or return types.

Used sparingly, var reduces noise in dense data-processing code. Used everywhere, it hides the type and hurts readability when the initializer does not make it clear. A good rule is to use var when the type is obvious from the expression, and spell out the type when inference would leave a reader guessing.
contentCn:
Java 10 引入了 var，让编译器能根据局部变量的初始化表达式推断其类型。写成 var users = new ArrayList<User>()，右边已经清楚地给出了具体类型，你就不必再重复一遍冗长的泛型签名。

理解 var 的“边界”很重要。它并非动态类型或弱类型特性——变量依然拥有一个精确的、在编译期就被检查出来的静态类型，生成的字节码也与显式写出类型完全一致。var 只能用于带有初始化表达式的局部变量，不能用于字段、方法参数或返回值。

适度使用 var，能减少密集数据处理代码中的噪声；处处都用，则会在初始化表达式看不出类型时掩盖信息、损害可读性。一个好的准则是：当类型从表达式中一眼可见时用 var，当推断会让读者犯嘀咕时，就把类型明明白白写出来。
titleEn: Local Variable Type Inference with var
titleCn: 用 var 做局部变量类型推断

title: Records for Immutable Data
contentMd:
Java 16 finalized records, a concise declaration for classes whose main job is to carry immutable data. Writing record Point(int x, int y) generates the fields, a canonical constructor, accessors, equals, hashCode, and toString, all of which previously demanded a page of boilerplate.

A record is immutable: the component fields are final and any method you add must not mutate them. You can customize behavior by declaring your own constructor, adding static factory methods, or implementing interfaces, but you cannot extend another class because records already inherit from Record.

In backend code, records are ideal for DTOs, API responses, and value objects that group a few related fields. They make illegal states unrepresentable and compare by value rather than identity, which fits the functional, data-oriented style encouraged by the Stream API. The trade-off is that a record is a poor fit for entities that need mutable state and lifecycle behavior.
contentCn:
Java 16 正式确定了 record（记录），它是对“以承载不可变数据为主要职责”的类的一种简洁声明。写下一行 record Point(int x, int y)，编译器就会生成字段、规范构造器、访问器、equals、hashCode 和 toString——而这些在过去需要满满一页样板代码。

record 是不可变的：组件字段是 final 的，你添加的任何方法都不得修改它们。你可以通过声明自己的构造器、添加静态工厂方法或实现接口来定制行为，但你不能再去继承别的类，因为 record 已经继承自 Record。

在后端代码中，record 非常适合 DTO、API 响应，以及把若干相关字段聚合起来的值对象（value object）。它让不合法的状态无法被表示出来，并且按值而非按身份进行比较，这正契合 Stream API 所倡导的函数式、面向数据的风格。代价在于：对于需要可变状态和生命周期行为的实体，record 并不合适。
titleCn: 用于不可变数据的 Record

title: Sealed Classes and Exhaustive Hierarchies
contentMd:
Sealed classes, finalized in Java 17, let a type restrict which other classes or interfaces may extend or implement it. By marking a superclass sealed and listing its permitted subclasses, you make the set of subtypes known to the compiler and closed to surprise additions.

This enables exhaustive checking in switch expressions. When the selector is a sealed type and the cases cover every permitted subtype, the compiler knows no other possibility exists and does not require a default branch. That turns a class hierarchy into a compile-time guarantee, so adding a new subtype forces you to handle it everywhere it matters.

Sealed types pair naturally with records to model algebraic data. A command hierarchy where every command is a record and the root is sealed gives you precise, self-documenting domain models. The balance is intentionality: sealing is most valuable when the set of variants is genuinely fixed, such as protocol messages or state machines, and less so when you expect third parties to extend your types.
contentCn:
Java 17 正式引入的密封类（sealed class），让一个类型能够限制到底有哪些类或接口可以继承或实现它。把父类标记为 sealed 并列出其允许的子类后，子类型的集合就对编译器已知、且不会再被意外扩展。

这让 switch 表达式能够进行穷尽式检查。当选择器是密封类型、且分支覆盖了每一个允许的子类时，编译器知道不存在其他可能，因而不再需要一个 default 分支。这等于把一个类层级变成了编译期保证：一旦新增一个子类型，编译器会强制你在所有相关的地方都处理它。

密封类型与 record 天然契合，可用来建模代数数据类型。比如一个命令层级：每个命令都是 record，根类型是 sealed，由此得到的领域模型既精确又自文档化。这里的关键在于“有意为之”：只有当变体集合确实固定时（例如协议消息或状态机），密封才最有价值；若你期望第三方来扩展你的类型，它就不太合适了。

title: Functional Interfaces and the Type System
contentMd:
A functional interface is an interface with exactly one abstract method, often annotated @FunctionalInterface to ask the compiler to enforce that constraint. This single-method shape is what lets a lambda or method reference be assigned to it, because the compiler knows precisely which method the behavior must implement.

Java ships a useful family in java.util.function: Predicate tests a condition, Function transforms input to output, Consumer acts on input without returning, Supplier provides a value, and the primitive-specialized variants like IntFunction avoid boxing. Defining your own named functional interface is worthwhile when a generic one would make call sites unclear.

In interviews, candidates sometimes confuse functional interfaces with lambdas. The lambda is the value, the functional interface is the type it conforms to. Understanding this distinction explains why you cannot assign a lambda to an interface with two abstract methods, and why method overloading that differs only by functional interface parameter types can become ambiguous at the call site.
contentCn:
函数式接口（functional interface）是只含一个抽象方法的接口，通常加上 @FunctionalInterface 注解，请编译器强制这一约束。正是这种“单方法”形态，使得 lambda 或方法引用能够被赋值给它——因为编译器确切知道这段行为要实现的是哪一个方法。

Java 在 java.util.function 中提供了一组实用家族：Predicate 判断条件，Function 把输入变换为输出，Consumer 消费输入但不返回，Supplier 提供一个值，而像 IntFunction 这样的原始类型特化变体则避免了装箱。当某个通用接口会让调用处含义模糊时，定义你自己的具名函数式接口是值得的。

面试中，有人会把函数式接口和 lambda 混为一谈。lambda 是“值”，函数式接口是它所遵从的“类型”。理解这一区别，就能解释为何不能把 lambda 赋给带有多个抽象方法的接口，以及为何仅靠函数式接口参数类型来区分的方法重载，在调用处可能变得含糊不清。
titleEn: Functional Interfaces and the Type System
titleCn: 函数式接口与类型系统

title: Effectively Final Variables
contentMd:
A variable is effectively final when it is assigned exactly once and never reassigned afterward, even though you did not write the final keyword. Lambda expressions and anonymous classes may only reference such variables from their enclosing scope, which is why a counter incremented in a loop cannot be captured by a lambda.

The restriction exists because lambdas can outlive the method frame that created them. If a captured local could change after capture, different threads or later invocations would observe inconsistent values, reintroducing the very concurrency bugs that the functional style tries to avoid. Treating captured variables as frozen keeps the model simple and safe.

When you genuinely need mutable state shared with a lambda, reach for an explicit container such as an array of one element or an AtomicInteger, or better, restructure so the value flows through the stream as data. An interviewer who asks about this is probing whether you understand closure capture and the difference between final and effectively final.
contentCn:
所谓“事实上的不可变（effectively final）”变量，是指虽然你没有写 final 关键字，但它只被赋值一次、此后便不再被重新赋值。Lambda 表达式和匿名类只能引用外围作用域中这类变量，这也解释了为什么循环里被不断自增的计数器无法被 lambda 捕获。

这条限制存在，是因为 lambda 的寿命可能长于创建它的那个方法栈帧。如果被捕获的局部变量在捕获之后还能改变，不同的线程或后续的调用就会观察到不一致的值，从而重新引入函数式风格本想规避的那类并发 bug。把被捕获的变量视作“冻结”，能让整个模型既简单又安全。

当你确实需要与 lambda 共享可变状态时，应改用显式的容器，例如一个长度为 1 的数组或 AtomicInteger；更好的做法则是重构，让这个值作为数据在流中流动。面试官问到这一点，其实是在考察你是否理解闭包捕获，以及 final 与 effectively final 之间的区别。

title: Parallel Streams and Their Costs
contentMd:
A sequential stream becomes parallel with a single parallel() call, after which the fork join pool splits the data into chunks and processes them on worker threads. For large, independent, CPU-bound workloads this can use all available cores and cut wall-clock time substantially.

The benefits are not free. Splitting, scheduling, and merging carry overhead, so small or quickly processed datasets often run slower in parallel. Worse, parallel streams share the common ForkJoinPool, so a slow or blocking operation in one place can starve unrelated parallel tasks across the whole application.

Correctness is the harder part. Parallel pipelines must be stateless and non-interfering; any shared mutable state, such as appending to a list during forEach, produces races. In an interview, the mature answer is not "parallel is faster" but "measure first, keep operations pure, and prefer explicit executors when you need isolation or control over the thread pool."
contentCn:
只要调用一次 parallel()，顺序流就会变成并行流，随后 fork join 池会把数据切分成多个分块，放在工作线程上处理。对于大型、相互独立、受 CPU 限制的负载，它能用满所有核心，显著缩短墙钟时间（wall-clock time）。

但收益并非免费。切分、调度与合并都有开销，所以数据量小或处理很快的数据集，并行反而常常更慢。更糟的是，并行流共享同一个公共 ForkJoinPool——某一处出现缓慢或阻塞的操作，就可能拖垮整个应用中其他毫不相关的并行任务。

更难的是正确性。并行流水线必须是无状态、互不干扰的；任何共享可变状态（比如在 forEach 中往一个列表里追加元素）都会引发竞争。面试中成熟的回答不是“并行更快”，而是“先测量，保持操作纯粹，并且当你需要隔离或对线程池加以控制时，优先使用显式的 executor”。

title: Grouping and Reducing with Collectors
contentMd:
The terminal operation collect turns a stream back into a concrete structure, and the Collectors factory provides the building blocks. The most common is toList or toMap, but groupingBy is where interviews get interesting, because it performs a map-reduce in a single pass over the data.

groupingBy(classifier) partitions elements by a key, while groupingBy(classifier, downstream) lets you summarize each group, for example counting members, averaging a field, or collecting them into a list. downstream collectors compose, so you can group orders by region and then find the highest-value order in each region without writing nested loops.

A frequent pitfall is toMap colliding on duplicate keys, which throws IllegalStateException unless you supply a merge function. Another is using collect when a simpler terminal such as count or max would do. Knowing when a collector is the right tool, and how downstream collectors nest, separates candidates who merely use streams from those who think in terms of aggregation.
contentCn:
终端操作 collect 把流重新变回一个具体结构，而 Collectors 工厂提供了所需的基础构件。最常用的是 toList 或 toMap，但 groupingBy 才是面试中最有意思的地方——它能在一遍遍历中完成一次 map-reduce。

groupingBy(classifier) 按某个键对元素做分区；而 groupingBy(classifier, downstream) 让你对每个分组做汇总，例如统计成员数、对某个字段求平均，或把它们收集成一个列表。下游收集器可以组合嵌套，于是你能在一次操作中按地区对订单分组，再找出每个地区里价值最高的那笔订单，无需写嵌套循环。

一个常见陷阱是 toMap 在遇到重复键时会抛出 IllegalStateException，除非你提供一个合并函数。另一个是用 collect 去做那些 count 或 max 等更简单的终端操作就能完成的活。知道何时该用收集器、以及下游收集器如何嵌套，正是“只是用用流”和“以聚合思维思考”的面试者之间的分水岭。
titleCn: 用 Collector 做分组与归约

title: Pattern Matching for switch
contentMd:
Pattern matching for switch, standardized in Java 21, lets a case test the type of the selector and bind it to a variable in one step. Instead of a chain of instanceof checks followed by casts, you write case String s -> s.length(), and the compiler proves the cast is safe and the binding is in scope.

Guarded patterns extend this with a when clause, so case Integer i when i > 0 lets you split behavior within a type without nesting if statements. Combined with sealed types, a switch over a known hierarchy can be exhaustively checked, removing the need for a default that merely throws an error.

The advantage over the classic switch is expressiveness and safety. You no longer repeat the variable name or perform manual casts, and the compiler catches missing cases for sealed types. Candidates who adopt pattern matching show they value code that states intent directly and leans on the compiler to enforce completeness.
contentCn:
Java 21 标准化了的 switch 模式匹配，让 case 能够一步完成“判断选择器类型”与“把结果绑定到变量”。你不再需要先写一串 instanceof 判断再做强制转换，而是直接写 case String s -> s.length()，编译器会证明该转换安全，且绑定变量在作用域内可用。

带守卫（guard）的模式进一步引入 when 子句，于是 case Integer i when i > 0 让你在同一类型内部按条件拆分行为，而不必嵌套 if 语句。再结合密封类型，对一个已知层级的 switch 就能做穷尽检查，从而不再需要一个“只会抛错”的 default 分支。

相较于经典 switch，它的优势在于表达力与安全性。你不必重复变量名，也不用手写强制转换，编译器还会针对密封类型捕获遗漏的分支。那些采用模式匹配的面试者，展现出的是对“让代码直陈意图、并借助编译器强制完整性”的看重。

title: Text Blocks for Multiline Strings
contentMd:
Java 15 finalized text blocks, delimited by triple quotes, to hold multiline string literals without concatenating plus signs or escaping newlines. A SQL query, a JSON payload, or an HTML fragment can now be written almost exactly as it appears in the editor.

The compiler applies incidental whitespace stripping so the block is not distorted by the indentation needed to keep your code tidy. You can still embed values with String.format or the formatted method, and a \ at the end of a line suppresses the line break when you need precise control.

Text blocks are a readability win for any backend code that embeds structured text, especially in tests and data-access layers. The caution is that they are still ordinary String objects, so concatenation inside a loop remains a performance concern and should use a builder. Know that they simplify literals, not heavy string assembly.
contentCn:
Java 15 正式确定了文本块（text block），用三重引号界定，用来承载多行字符串字面量，无需再用加号拼接或转义换行符。一条 SQL 查询、一段 JSON 负载，或一个 HTML 片段，如今几乎可以按照它在编辑器里的样子原样写下来。

编译器会执行“附带空白剥离（incidental whitespace stripping）”，因此代码为保持整齐所需的缩进不会扭曲文本内容。你依然可以用 String.format 或 formatted 方法嵌入变量；而在行末加一个反斜杠 \，则能在你需要精确控制时抑制换行。

对于任何会在内嵌结构化文本的 Java 后端代码，文本块都是可读性的胜利，在测试层和数据库访问层尤其明显。需要警惕的是：它们本质上仍是普通的 String 对象，因此在循环里拼接字符串依旧是性能隐患，应当使用 builder。要明白文本块简化的是字面量，而非繁重的字符串组装。
titleCn: 用于多行字符串的文本块
